scope: Test harness correctness; not an explanation of the owner's already-completed driver restart.
changes: Enable SeShutdownPrivilege before XP ExitWindowsEx; report failures and remove a false boot marker if the shutdown request fails.
Host relaunch waits for an actual 8042/CF9 reset after the initial boot, not only REBOOT_REQUEST text.
Use multiplication for 2048 MiB; signed <<20 produced a negative memory_size. Restore checks use the same unsigned byte size.
Do not mask initialization failures by exporting absent floppy/display devices, and return failure when a caught error exists.

builds: XP and Win98 C probe builds with -Wall -Wextra -Werror and existing cast-function-type, unused-function, Win98 misleading-indentation warnings excluded
